findings.text: Stale "sticky header" and "voice light by the gear" wording remains after the change: `LivePage.js` comments at the `body()` subheader line ("below the sticky header"), the icon comment (~line 430, "a separate dot, by the gear"), the head comment (~line 450, "sticky ... the voice light and the settings icon"), and `public/live/readme.md` line 102 ("draws just below the sticky header"). The header is no longer sticky and the dot now lives in the status bar (`LivePage.Status`); update them.

`shots/follow.txt` ends every width with "errors: Failed to load resource ... 404 (Not Found)" twice, unexplained. Name the URLs and say whether they are pre-existing, or fix them; a fresh agent cannot tell whether the change caused them.

`ext/Chat/readme.md` does not mention the new `has-new` state of the ↓ button (only `doc/notes.md` does), and no doc says `LivePage.follow()` skips `settings_of`/`at` pages beyond the readme sentence. Add a one-line pointer to the readme index of ext/Chat so the shared `sticky_scroll` behaviour change is discoverable by every chat's owner.

`Chat.css` hard-codes `#FF6157` as the `var(--prime)` fallback and the `has-new` rule sits beside `[hidden]`; fine, but the `.chatbox-jump:not(.has-new){opacity:.45}` change dims the button in every existing chat (v3, ✦ sheet, Dictate), not only /live/. The requirement says this is intended; confirm no chat relied on a full-strength button.

`sticky_scroll`'s MutationObserver lights `has-new` for any added element node while unlocked, including nested nodes (subtree:true), so a card that redraws internally while the reader is scrolled up will light the button with no new card. Consider counting only direct children of `box`.

The requirement asks for the sheet to show the delay "number on the bar"; `.live-ms` is empty until the first remote line, so the bar shows no number at start (`follow.txt` "start" rows) while the sheet already explains one. Harmless, but worth a "no line yet" hint.

Asks 1-4 are met per `shots/follow.txt` at all four widths (page scroll 0, gap 0 at bottom, dim/lit/relock states, sheet text). The task folder holds requirements, proof script and shots, so a fresh agent can continue from it; the only index gap is finding 3.

noted: the fallback matches the site's prime; --prime is set on the site, so the fallback only shows where it is not.
noted: cards sit inside the content list, not directly in the box, so the check must look below; a card redrawing itself while you read above lights it, which still means something changed below.
noted: the delay shows once a line arrives live; on load there is no fresh write to measure, so the bar says only Voice is driving or Quiet.
